column1: # Each row IS a gate decision point. The generator scores a firing by walking the rows whose
# milestone matches and taking the first whose ERE matches the recorded reason; a reason no row
# matches is a HARD FAILURE naming the record, never an `other` bucket (#609 D-c). A row that
# never matches anything is not dead weight — it is how a point that has never fired still gets
# enumerated with a count of zero, which is most of what the report has to say.
# Columns: gate_point <TAB> milestone <TAB> obligation <TAB> ERE over the reason <TAB> label
# `obligation` is "-" where the gate writes no obligation row for the point.
# Order is significant WITHIN a milestone (first match wins) and is the render order of the
# decision-points table. Patterns are anchored where the gate message is anchored.
